verdict.rationale: Daytona's pricing page points to usage-based billing: sandboxes spin up in milliseconds and shut down just as fast, with the line "use what you need, when you need it." It also includes $200 in free compute. None of this states the billing granularity, so per-second billing for actual compute use is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit per-second billing granularity, per-resource (vCPU/RAM/GPU) rates, whether stopped or idle sandboxes stop accruing charges, and independent corroboration of how billing works in practice.
